title: Local Jewelry Leads
description: CaratBase sends local leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers and appraisers from people selling gold, seeking appraisals or buying rings.
html:
Local Jewelry Leads

CaratBase sends local leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers: people who want to sell gold, get an appraisal, or purchase an engagement ring. The first 3 leads are free; each accepted lead after that costs $40.

What You Get

  • Local leads – Starting with Atlanta, with other regions planned.
  • Optional Pro website widget – $12/month.

Why Choose CaratBase

  • Cost-transparent pricing – You pay only for leads you accept, a flat $40 after the 3 free leads.
  • Built for independents – Aimed at small jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers.

FAQ

How much does it cost? The first 3 leads are free. After that, each accepted lead costs $40. A Pro website widget is optional at $12/month.

Can I use CaratBase if I'm not in Atlanta? CaratBase is starting in Atlanta and plans to expand to other metros.

Next Step
